question: Do the twelve deposited CD8 comparison tables provide uniquely mapped finite source-reported estimates for IFNG, GZMB and IL18RAP at both dimer doses?
decision: Permit a narrower descriptive comparison of published estimates, while holding the failed common-expression-matrix contrast.
strongest_rival: Keyword matches, inconsistent replicate labels, duplicated control columns or shared source reuse can falsely imply a matched biological comparison.
discriminator: Check explicit source-pair schema, all-row ID uniqueness and exact three-target identity/finite estimate status, with no gene-effect calculation.
exposure_record: Saxton/Gorby published results, Saxton source results, worksheet header/dimensions and public metadata were inspected before freeze. Gorby target abundance contrasts have not been inspected; this remains exposed source qualification. The first row of one source table was GZMB and viewed during header inspection. No target choices changed; cross-ligand contrasts remain uninspected.
biological_unit: Public sample metadata and matrix records; author-reported donors and source blocks are distinguished from independently verified identities.
nesting_and_overlap: Queries overlap and SuperSeries/subseries are not independent. Repeated worksheet control columns are copies, not new samples. Cross-study donor overlap is unresolved.
population_and_selection: Exactly the recorded queries and their complete returned records, or the full deposited CD8 workbook and its 21 source columns; no outcome selection.
contrast: Source eligibility against the prewritten extension tuple; not a biological treatment-effect contrast.
endpoint: Source table identity and fixed-target estimate availability, not a direct expression-matrix contrast.
methods: See SOURCE_AMENDMENT_V2.md. Parse the twelve linked per-comparison tables; keep literal NA missing and retain original normalized-matrix failure.
missingness_and_exclusions: All hits retained. Unknown units and missing arms remain explicit; stop on truncated searches or unreviewed records. No target replacement or invented arm.
multiplicity: No statistical tests; metadata qualification only.
precision_basis: Source intake estimates no population quantity or uncertainty; donor/endpoint qualification is the deliverable.
interpretation_limit: Metadata eligibility is not biological acceptance, statistical independence, signaling, secretion or interaction evidence.
stop_rule: Stop on schema/hash mismatch or missing query records; report absent/ambiguous targets and invalid source values rather than repairing silently.
amendment_reason: Exact-byte serialization freeze correction; preserve v1 code/config/contracts and the original Gorby noneligible metadata result. No biological contrasts calculated. In addition, v1 found nonidentical repeated controls and literal NA; a new source/endpoint qualification replaces the common-matrix proposal without relaxing that failed eligibility.
